items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: He played with me, I got him for a couple of nights about three years ago.

ctx.x: He's from Little Rock or Hot Springs?
He played with me, I got him for a couple of nights about three years ago. He just couldn't keep up. That's right; that's who was there. And we were playing for Peanuts there.
